title: Bounded derived objects have bounded complex representatives
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category with a derived category $D(\mathcal A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and let $K\in D(\mathcal A)$ have $H^i(K)=0$ for all $i<a$ and all $i>b$ for some integers $a\le b$. Then there exist a cochain complex $P^\bullet$ in $\mathcal A$ with $P^i=0$ for $i<a$ and $i>b$, and an isomorphism $K\cong Q(P^\bullet)$ in $D(\mathcal A)$, where $Q$ is the localization functor.

source.place: lemma DerivedCategory.exists_iso_Q_obj_of_isGE_of_isLE, lines 180–186 (specialized to the standard t-structure)
